_about: Operation ledger for phase B (design pass). 'rect'/'ellipse' are element numbers of references/page-spec.json; 'ribbon' names one of the six identical copies of element 1. Modes use PowerPoint's Merge Shapes names: intersect = 相交, subtract = 剪除 (first shape minus the second).
_naming_note: Element labels are the ones the brief uses; they are carried into design.json and the verifier so every intermediate result stays traceable.
_brief_resolution: The brief's step 9 says 'reference images b to f (5 images) with elements 12-2 to 12-5 (5 elements)' -- 12-2..12-5 is only four elements, while the stated output 13-2..13-6 is five. Five images require five elements, so the mapping used here is 12-2..12-6 <- b..f. Reference image g is not consumed by the brief.

fill_rule.scale: k = max(element_width / image_pixel_width, element_height / image_pixel_height); scaleX = scaleY = k
fill_rule.scale_semantics: In this Facade a tile scale of k renders one tile k × image pixels wide/high in slide points, so k computed as above makes a single tile exactly cover the element (cover fit) with no seam.

stroke.note: The brief gives transparency (透明度): 100% / 0% / 100%. The Facade stores opacity, so the ledger keeps both columns -- opacity = 1 - transparency. In OOXML this becomes a:gs alpha 0 / 100000 / 0 at pos 20000 / 50000 / 80000.
